candidates.issues: The title «Пирожные» loses the 'cups' notion slightly. Otherwise accurate and natural.
Omits «с сахаром» for the condensed milk. Omits 'spoon' in the cream step. The title mixes a Cyrillic transliteration with Latin brand names used elsewhere.
«Десерт в формочках» is a somewhat generic title. Otherwise accurate and fluent.
«Корзиночки» is an apt rendering of 'cups'. Accurate and idiomatic throughout; no notable issues.
Keeps an unnecessary comma in the last ingredient. «Поломайте» is slightly less idiomatic. «до полного застывания» is a minor addition.
«топлёного масла» (ghee) mistranslates 'melted butter'. «4 батончиков» is a grammar error. «Капкейки» is inaccurate and inconsistent with «корзинки». «Выложите маффинную форму» is awkward.
